entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item.
I can certainly help with that. To get started, could I have your order number, please?
Thank you. I see you purchased a VeloFit Aero helmet. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I understand. We certainly want you to be happy with the look of your gear. Getting the right fit and feel is also crucial for your safety on the road. Can you confirm there are no defects with the helmet itself?
Look, the box is unopened. I just don't want it. Are you going to help me or not?

Yes, absolutely. Thank you for clarifying. I've confirmed your purchase date was 21 days ago. Since the helmet is a standard item, it's unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy. I've just approved the return for you.

I'm generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any carrier location. You'll receive a full refund once it arrives back at our warehouse.
Whatever. Just make sure it actually works.
It will. You can even track the return with the number on the label. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good afternoon.
